# Name related calendar test tasks for both their view and their scenario

The historical patch names all three tasks testStartOfWeek. Accepted code uses testWeekViewStartOfWeek, testMonthViewStartOfWeek and testMultiweekViewStartOfWeek. Follow this current naming pattern for comparable view tests so a failure identifies the view and behavior. Keep local camelCase task naming; the test-file browser_ prefix is a separate harness convention. This is a scoped pattern, not a request to rename all existing tasks.

Scope: calendar/test/browser.
